polityNote: Syrian Republic (from 22 Feb 1958 to 28 Sep 1961 the Northern Region of the United Arab Republic; governorates continued) and Syrian Arab Republic. The governorates (muhafazat) from the creation of Idlib and al-Rashid (17 Nov 1957) to the day before SYR.json (Natural Earth, 1974-06-26 onward) begins. Atoms: geoBoundaries SYR ADM2 (61 districts, OCHA/UN Cartographic Section, CC BY 3.0 IGO, 2017) — finer than Natural Earth and including the Golan districts, which stay unresolved here. Independent check (①), union area ÷ the official area in ar.Wikipedia’s governorate table (oldid 74603004, Central Bureau of Statistics figures): Aleppo 1.07, Idlib 0.89, Raqqa 0.90, Deir ez-Zor 0.76, Hasakah 0.99, Hama 1.25, Homs 1.02, Suwayda 1.15, Latakia 1.04, Tartus 0.99 (Dar’a 1.03, Quneitra 0.92, Rif Dimashq 1.46 — unresolved here). The desert lines (Deir ez-Zor / Homs / Rif Dimashq / Hama / Raqqa) of the OCHA districts disagree with the official areas by up to 8,000 km²; which modern line is right is not settled by this dossier, and the same question applies to the Natural Earth lines of SYR.json. Earlier layouts (1946–1957: Aleppo with Idlib, Euphrates with al-Rashid; mandate states before 1946) are not drawn: they would be unions of the same atoms but the dossier has no change list proving the lines for 1946–1957.
